title: Great bike tour
text: Great tour with good explanations and a friendly guide. The group size was reasonable and the bikes had a acceptable quality
author: Michael N

title: Great Experience
text: The view was amazing! Angie is so kind and funny. My mom and I are from Indiana, and we had a great time. It was so fun, and I would recommend this to someone who is visiting Barcelona to learn about this beautiful city!
author: lexil469

title: In-depth history about Gaudi and more - a great ride!
text: We had a perfect day for our tour with Angie! The three hours flew by as we weaved our way through the streets of Barcelona on a beach cruiser (my watch mapped it out at about 5mi/8km). We stopped at Casa Batlló, Casa Mila and La Sagrada, but veered off for other stops along the way to appreciate the city's art. Angie has in-depth knowledge of Gaudi's work and offered a unique perspective. I especially appreciated that it was just two of us with Angie on the tour, allowing for a more exclusive experience than some of the larger groups we saw riding around!
author: docreiner

title: A fab wee tour
text: What a fantastic tour with Angie who was very knowledgeable with a great sense of humour!! Thanks for a wonderful experience
